name: FreeCell Mobile Classic
shortDescription: A responsive FreeCell clone with touch, keyboard controls, undo, auto-move, and win detection.

suggestion.prompt: Create a FreeCell clone that works well on mobile devices. Requirements: fully playable game with standard FreeCell rules, new game, undo, win detection, move counter, and desktop/mobile usability.

generation.notes: Implemented a static FreeCell game with 8 tableau columns, 4 free cells, 4 foundations, move validation, undo support, and auto-move assistance.
